description:
DOWNLOAD LINK HERE

"and a great burning star fell from the sky,

and a mountain fell into the sea and the water turned to blood, and the

moon and stars and sun turned dark"

The Eusan Nation is an independent star system, existing in the Persean Sector in a precarious state. Since the Gate system shutdown, the star system has been in a constant state of change. Originally a prosperous Domain era colony, the chaos that followed after the Gate shutdown saw the rise of the Eusan Empire. The Empire brutally crushed all rivals and established itself as the sole government in the system. Many decades later, a miner revolt on a toxic moon resulted in a multi-decade struggle against the Empire. In the following decades, Vineta's moon was shattered, Kitezh's vast farmlands ruined, and millions starved under the Empire's blockade. This continued until the Nation laid siege to Buyan, killed the Last Empress and finally emerging victorious over a shattered star system. Now the sole uncontested ruler, the Nation must keep itself afloat as it attempts to build a nation from the ruins of the old one while navigating the Persean Sector filled with predators waiting to strike at weakness.

On the capital planet of Heimat, a young silver haired woman working for the Nation realizes her workload is too large to handle herself. Perhaps it is time to find outside help...

Poster by anonymousyyiek

CHANGELOG

Spoiler
v0.1.4g
- Fixing Issues with rules.csv regarding entry to 512 mission with more clear instructions and flags.
- Fixing issues with fleet not intercepting player fleets. Changed back to patrol for now.

v0.1.4f
- AEON Facility code rewritten by Kaysaar.
- Adding 4 new portraits with 2 variants.
- Delete obsolete portraits.

v0.1.4e
- Temporary commenting out isHidden() and IsFunctional() on Eusan_Nation_Aeon_Facility.java due to issues related to the concept.
- Adding weapon sounds to the Type 71 built-in, Dangpa, Dory, Galdae, Kompakt, Pebble Hail, Pernach, and Wuiquong.
- Updating Vineta planet and cloud textures to be softer and less dark.
- Small grammar changes in rules.csv
- Fixing an issue with Ariane's menu dialog because things got omitted.

v0.1.4d
- Adding new Luddic path and Church topics to The Daughter.
- Fixing structure not showing correct illustration for AEON Facility.
- Adding industry/structure illustrations for AEON HQ, AEON Facility, Defense Coordination, Rotfront Hydroponics, and Rotfront Array.
- Added two blueprint icons, Advanced and Standard.
- Fixing issues with negative or 999999 ammo for missile weapons with infinite ammo like the Salamander.
- Adding Null Checks and fixing AEON Facility issues. Ongoing work to AOTD proof it from errors.

v0.1.4c
- Rules.csv typo fixes. (Homete)
- Fixed Falke fleet from wandering away because the assignment ends in 365 days after game start. (Homete)
- Fixed shield too close to hull on some ship: Lerche "always_panic" hint (Sikair)
- Sound added to hybrid rocket weapons (Sikair)
- Pebble hail: 25->22 damage (Sikair)
- Wuqiong: fire twice in a burst (Sikair)
- Kompakt: higher rof but can run out of ammo (Sikair)
- Rogatina: tighter spread on first two shots (Sikair)
- Taean: 3x200->3x300 damage but fires slower (Sikair)
- added a new shipsystem (not in use) (Sikair)
- Changed triglav desc and flux buff (Sikair)
- naval gun proj now pierce missile (Sikair)

v0.1.4b
-Null String fixes for Aeon Facility
-Rules CSV fixes to avoid soft lockout and progression issues.

v0.1.4a
- Initial Release Version

v0.1.3
- Update version to Starsector 0.98a

v0.1.2
- Update version to Starsector 0.97a

v0.1.1
- Adding faction files
- Update version to Starsector 0.96a

v0.1.0
- Initial 0.95 dev version based of prototype star system mod.

QA

Spoiler
1 - Will this be compatible with my saves?
- Assume that you need to create a new save to use this mod. 

2 - Why did you take so long?
- I had to ensure the basic items are complete. You're looking at a hefty bill for artwork and music. No substitute for shortcuts.

3 - Why anime?
- Why not?

4- Is there a discord or place where I can hang out to discuss this mod or report bugs?
- No there is no discord or any special place to hang out. You can find me on other discords or use this forum to report bugs or give feedback.

5 - What about the memes?
- The memes came after I started developing this mod.

6- "Oh boy a faction I like I can't wait to role play my deepest desires..."
- Don't be weird.
